annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2018/988 amending and correcting Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/656 on administrative requirements for emission limits and type-approval of internal combustion engines for non-road mobile machinery
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2018/988 amending and correcting Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/656 on administrative requirements for emission limits and type-approval of internal combustion engines for non-road mobile machinery
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 182
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing regulation amending and correcting templates and administrative requirements for emission type-approval of internal combustion engines in non-road mobile machinery under Regulation 2016/1628. It harmonises terminology, adds test-report and certificate fields, and sets transitional provisions. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Inserts Article 12a transitional rules: type-approvals under old version allowed until 31 Dec 2018, placing on market until 30 June 2019
Requires copies of demonstration reports in the engine information folder
Adds in-service monitoring reference work and CO2 mass to type-approval certificate addendum and test report
Replaces 'displacement' terms with 'swept volume per cylinder' and 'engine total swept volume'
Corrects errors in templates and engine family criteria
